archetypes.name: dyn-gate-b-flow
archetypes.rationale: Gate B CLI ownership now spans preview, counts, and one-by-one prompt routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Gate B flow across python/plan_review.py and approval-gates.md. Focus on whether preview, counts, and gate-b-finding-line share the same parser and display labels. Check that Gate B no longer relies on orchestrator-side classification or contiguous finding ids. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-rubric-fallback
archetypes.rationale: Fallback severity bucketing now implements prefer-lower semantics from concern text.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the fallback severity classifier and tests. Verify that mixed structured and unstructured findings switch the whole set to fallback mode, that multiple predicate matches choose the lowest bucket, and that empty concerns still count as Low without affecting continuation logic. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
